referenceHost: Linux x64, AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, 24 logical CPUs; record actual RAM, affinity, load and power context for each run
purpose: Absolute responsiveness and resource ceilings for the implemented foundation workloads. These are engineering targets, not observed results or rendering-derived simulation claims.

inputs.rules: Complete independently authored F03 rule sections from tests/rules_cli.py; do not read an original game installation
inputs.pack: Repository format-demonstration content with two authored parent overlays; pinned manifests and files
inputs.sessionCommand: Production LocalUnitCommands.StackBottom over an owned coherent three-unit stack, real lease/submit/confirm/advance/result/retire

policy: A repeatable matched-workload median regression above 20% requires investigation even below absolute budgets. Failures cannot be hidden by averaging workloads, dropping slow samples or silently raising these ceilings; record any reviewed tradeoff explicitly. Browser and native timings are separate populations. Allocation budgets are managed allocations, never native RSS or GC pauses.
